name: Urgency
description: How soon responsive action should be taken, from OASIS CAP 1.2. One of three axes - with severity and certainty - that together let a receiving system decide whether to interrupt someone.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Immediate
hasDefinedTerm.description: Responsive action should be taken immediately.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Expected
hasDefinedTerm.description: Responsive action should be taken soon, within the next hour.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Future
hasDefinedTerm.description: Responsive action should be taken in the near future.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Past
hasDefinedTerm.description: Responsive action is no longer required.
